To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

A single CSV or excel file of speed camera citation data from January 1st 2019 to November 6th 2026 with the following fields:
- Infraction Date YYYY/MM/DD
- Infraction Time HH:MM:SS
- Location ex: NB 132nd Ave NE
- Speed in MPH ex: 27.5 
- Fine in dollars ex: $136.00
- License plate ex: ABC 123
- Vehicle registration zip code ex: 98034
- Car Make ex: Honda
- Certifying officer or Person ex: Vick Muir
- Certified date YYYY/MM/DD
- Certified Time HH:MM
- Citation issued date: YYYY/MM/DD
- Citation reply due date: YYYY/MM/DD
- Failed to respond by due date: Yes or No
- Total late fee amount: ex: $75.35
- Fine sent to a collection agency: Yes or No
- Requested Mitigation hearing: Yes or No
- Fine amount after mitigation hearing ex: $86.00 or leave blank if it doesn't apply
- Requested contested hearings: Yes or No
- Motion for reconsideration filed: Yes or No
- Case number ex: ABC202503
- Case disposition: ex: Dismissed(D), Committed(C), Not Committed(NC), ... 
- Submitted affidavit stating that they were not the driver of the vehicle: Yes or No
- Liability transferred to the identified driver: Yes or No

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Moreno Morales

title: SB1421 Protest (Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Senate Bill 1421 I'm requesting all bodycam footage, recordings, and investigative reports. Please include materials presented to the district attorney or to whoever decides discipline, the findings, and the disciplinary records.

The records are related to any use of force from the various protests in June 2025 through August 2025 that caused great bodily injury. The law requires you provide "clear and convincing evidence" for its delay now that it is past the 45-day and 60-day limit. 

"If an agency delays disclosure pursuant to this clause, the agency shall, at 180-day intervals as necessary, provide, in writing, the specific basis for the agency’s determination that disclosure could reasonably be expected to interfere with a criminal enforcement proceeding. The writing shall include the estimated date for the disclosure of the withheld information. Information withheld by the agency shall be disclosed when the specific basis for withholding is resolved, when the investigation or proceeding is no longer active, or by no later than 18 months after the date of the incident, whichever occurs sooner."

If video footage is presented in a critical incident video, please provide the full, unedited version of the footage.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Joey Scott
